description: Exchange-local trading date and civil/incoming night attribution. Mainland China and the 24 MO scopes; SGX is equity/FX/rates, HKEX is cash equities. Outside published coverage is unknown. Official exchange notices take precedence.

date.description: Valid calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form, e.g. 2026-11-06, interpreted as the exchange-local trading date rather than UTC; omitted = today in the exchange/product time zone (UTC fallback if the zone is unavailable).

exchange.description: Exchange code: SHFE, INE, DCE, CZCE, GFEX, CFFEX, SGE, SSE, SZSE, BSE, HKEX, NB, SB, TWSE, KRX, JPX, SGX, BMD, LME, ICE, COMEX, CBOT, CME, NYSE, NYMEX, EUREX or OSE; case-insensitive (shfe becomes SHFE), or an FC product slug such as shfe-cu (lowercased), at most 40 characters; required unless marked optional, with results limited to published coverage.

name: trading_day
